## Founder / CEO summary
Skand Vijay is the founder and CEO of The ScopeMind. He is a founding engineer and founding-member profile builder focused on 0→1 products, developer infrastructure, and agentic AI. He is open to founding, founding-member, and CEO-level conversations.
